title: Towards Scalable Automated Alignment of LLMs: A Survey
reasoning: The paper reviews methodologies for aligning LLMs with human values and expectations, including sections on social interactions and human shared-values. It specifically references and discusses studies on moral reasoning, moral discussions (e.g., MoralDial), and the elicitation of values (e.g., Moral Graph Elicitation) as well as ethical boundaries for autonomous systems.
